## Start with a goal {.section-heading}

Choose the outcome closest to what you need. You can refine the results with additional filters.

```{=html}
<div class="goal-grid">
<a class="goal-card learn-filter-trigger no-external" data-set-facet="topic" data-set-value="Getting Started" href="?topic=Getting%20Started#all-learning-materials">
  <h3>Get started</h3>
  <p>Choose an analysis path and learn the foundations for working with genomic data.</p>
  <span class="goal-link">Browse this topic <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></span>
</a>

<a class="goal-card learn-filter-trigger no-external" data-set-facet="topic" data-set-value="Genotype Data" href="?topic=Genotype%20Data#all-learning-materials">
  <h3>Prepare genotype data</h3>
  <p>Import, inspect, transform, and export genotype or variant data for downstream analysis.</p>
  <span class="goal-link">Browse this topic <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></span>
</a>

<a class="goal-card learn-filter-trigger no-external" data-set-facet="topic" data-set-value="Data Quality" href="?topic=Data%20Quality#all-learning-materials">
  <h3>Improve data quality</h3>
  <p>Evaluate depth, missingness, markers, samples, and uncertainty before analysis.</p>
  <span class="goal-link">Browse this topic <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></span>
</a>

<a class="goal-card learn-filter-trigger no-external" data-set-facet="topic" data-set-value="Ploidy &amp; Dosage" href="?topic=Ploidy%20%26%20Dosage#all-learning-materials">
  <h3>Analyze polyploids</h3>
  <p>Work with allele dosage, ploidy, aneuploidy, and copy-number variation.</p>
  <span class="goal-link">Browse this topic <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></span>
</a>

<a class="goal-card learn-filter-trigger no-external" data-set-facet="topic" data-set-value="File Formats" href="?topic=File%20Formats#all-learning-materials">
  <h3>Understand data formats</h3>
  <p>Learn what specialized breeding-data files contain and how they relate to standard formats.</p>
  <span class="goal-link">Browse this topic <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></span>
</a>

<a class="goal-card learn-filter-trigger no-external" data-set-facet="topic" data-set-value="Genomic Prediction" href="?topic=Genomic%20Prediction#all-learning-materials">
  <h3>Predict performance</h3>
  <p>Interpret validation designs and results used in genomic prediction.</p>
  <span class="goal-link">Browse this topic <span aria-hidden="true">→</span></span>
</a>
</div>
```
